scope: Reduce the active model-task confirmation from training seeds 42/43/44 to seeds 42/43 only, prioritizing turnaround time and a fixed conclusion for this exact model and math-RL task. This is an explicit deviation from the original three-seed preregistration and must be disclosed.
user_direction: Temporarily run only two seeds, accelerate the experiment, and fix the conclusion on this model and task.

known: Complete seed-42 I0/I8/I16/I32 training and six-benchmark results.
I8 was selected from mixed candidates using seed 42.
unobserved: All seed-43 I8 training and evaluation results.

superseded_active_scope.interpretation: The original three-seed stable-generalization gate becomes unevaluable under the amended scope; it is not considered passed or failed.

two_seed_descriptive_checks.hierarchical_bootstrap: Report the two-seed training-seed/problem bootstrap interval and probability as descriptive uncertainty only; do not equate a two-seed interval with a well-estimated seed population.

decision_policy.fixed_model_task_replication: Allowed only if the seed-43 unfiltered gate, seed-43 fixed-overlap-filtered gate, and all two-seed descriptive checks pass.
decision_policy.promising_but_not_fixed: If seed 43 is positive but any gate fails, report the exact result and call the method promising or seed-sensitive; do not claim the conclusion is fixed.
decision_policy.failure: If seed-43 macro delta is non-positive in either unfiltered or fixed-filtered evaluation, the I8 method fails the amended confirmation.
decision_policy.no_i32_rescue: Seed-42 I32 cannot rescue a failed I8 confirmation. Any I32 follow-up remains a separately disclosed Phase-1b experiment.

allowed_claim_if_passed.english: In this fixed 1.5B math-RL setting, the I8 initialization improvement over the matched random-orthogonal baseline replicated on one held-out training seed and was positive on both tested seeds.
allowed_claim_if_passed.chinese: 在该固定 1.5B 数学 RL 设置中，I8 相对匹配随机正交基线的提升在一个未参与选择的训练 seed 上得到复现，并在两个已测试 seed 上均为正。

disallowed_claims: Broadly generalizes across models, tasks, domains, or datasets.
The original three-seed preregistered gate passed.
Superior to standard LoRA before a protocol-matched standard LoRA comparison is completed.

paper_baseline_scope.claim_without_standard_lora: Only superiority over the matched random-orthogonal I0 baseline, not over standard PEFT LoRA.
paper_baseline_scope.future_seed44: May be added later as an explicitly subsequent robustness extension; it cannot be silently folded into this amended two-seed decision.

controller_boundary_guard.action: Send SIGSTOP to PGID 27424 before the controller can proceed to seed 44, then require manual artifact verification and controller termination.

researcher_degrees_of_freedom: No threshold, exclusion set, benchmark, averaging unit, or claim wording may be relaxed after observing seed-43 evaluation results.
